title: HermesProfileCatalog
description: Draft: versioned catalog of Hermes profiles and shared config for Local Hermes. Materialized into the host Hermes data directory (~/.hermes) at container start or via sync script — not a replacement for Hermes on-disk layout.

catalog_version.description: Semver or date stamp for the catalog bundle

shared_config.description: Optional fragments merged into Hermes config.yaml at sync time

kanban_defaults.description: Optional kanban section defaults (dispatch_in_gateway, board id, etc.)

profile_id.description: Hermes profile directory name under profiles/

role.description: Battleplan-facing role for UI and connector routing

source_path.description: Path relative to catalog root containing SOUL.md, .env.template, config fragments

battleplan_connector_id.description: Optional link to project connectors[].connector_id when kind=hermes

capabilities.description: Tags for matching tasks (shell, mcp, browser, kanban_orchestrator, …)

api_server_port.description: Per-profile API_SERVER_PORT when exposing /v1 externally (8642 default profile only otherwise)
